turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Anaya from U GRO Capital. Am I speaking with the owner, or whoever handles the finances? Just so you know, I'm an AI assistant, not a human agent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. I'm calling about your business loan enquiry. Is now a good time? It takes about two minutes to check what you'd be eligible for.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, this is a good time. Please go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's the name of your business?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sharada Textiles

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And is that registered as a proprietorship, a partnership, an LLP, or a private limited company?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it's a proprietorship

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What line of business are you in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We deal in fabric and textile trading, mainly selling sarees and other home textiles

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How long has the business been running?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We have been running since 2018, so about 7 years now

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Roughly what was your turnover in the last financial year?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Around 72 lakh rupees last financial year

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And how much are you looking to borrow?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We need about 15 lakh rupees for working capital before the festive season

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any business loan EMIs running at the moment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, we do not have any business loan EMIs running at the moment

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Coming back to where we were - Any loan instalments going out each month at the moment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, no installments going out each month right now

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the business GST registered?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, we are GST registered

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Based on what you've told me, this looks like it fits our criteria, so I'll pass it to a credit officer for an in-principle review. Your business structure is eligible for our unsecured business loan. Before I arrange that, is there anything you want to ask me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll have someone call you back on this number. Does Thursday at 10 am work for you? Thanks for your time, and all the best with the business.
